prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter-length demi statue portrait, five-material body (symmetric), every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Ukrainian woman in folk-portrait makeup — fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, long light-brown hair in a thick braid over one shoulder, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a small delicate flower stud.

Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — shoulders more than four times a normal woman's width, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, no waist at all, hips as broad as the shoulders, her left arm crystal, her right arm carved stone, her torso a glass vessel, her thigh-stubs wood and wood.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent soft pink rose quartz, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid white Carrara marble veined with soft grey streaks, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled completely to the brim with clear clear periwinkle-blue water with drifting feathers, no hollow space, no air gap. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through it, rising to the collarbone line itself.

Left thigh (hip to tip): carved from ONE solid block of deep reddish-brown rosewood streaked with black, completely opaque, completely opaque. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her left thigh curves inward and rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there. Right thigh (hip to tip): carved from ONE solid block of deep reddish-brown rosewood streaked with black, completely opaque, completely opaque. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her right thigh curves inward and rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep royal blue on one side and a warm golden orange on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so blue light glances off one side and orange light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
